summary.zh: 画面先被压成一条发亮的细线，再缩成一个点，然后熄灭；开机就倒着放。做转场、关弹窗都很有梗。
summary.en: The picture squashes into a bright line, shrinks to a dot, then goes dark; power-on is the same thing reversed. A fun transition or modal close.

technique.zh: 四个关键帧：scale(1,1) → scale(1.02, 2px/高) 同时 brightness(3) → scale(6px/宽, 2px/高) → scale(0)；倒放时把 offset 换成 1-offset。
technique.en: Four keyframes: scale(1,1) → scale(1.02, 2px/h) with brightness(3) → scale(6px/w, 2px/h) → scale(0); for power-on reverse the list and map offset to 1 − offset.

adapt.zh: 拿 frames() 给任何一个容器用就行，比如关闭弹窗时对弹窗内容播一遍。
adapt.en: Apply frames() to any container, e.g. play it on a modal’s content when closing.
